about.title: About Us
about.intro: An Arabic-first learning platform that connects expert instructors with students looking for practical, structured learning.

s1.heading: Our mission
s1.body: We believe good education should be available to everyone, in a language they understand. That is why we offer practical courses taught by experienced instructors.

s2.heading: What we offer
s2.body: Recorded courses organised into chapters and lessons, quizzes to check understanding, live classes, and verifiable certificates of completion.

s3.heading: For instructors
s3.body: Any expert can apply to teach. Every course is reviewed by the admin team before it is published, to keep content quality high.

s4.heading: For students
s4.body: Learn at your own pace, track your progress in every course, and earn a certificate when you finish the lessons and pass the quizzes.

help.title: Help Center
help.intro: Quick answers to what students and instructors need most.

s1.heading: Account and sign-in
s1.body: If you forgot your password, use the "Forgot password" page to receive a reset link by email. You can change your password later from Settings.

s2.heading: Enrolling in courses
s2.body: Free courses open immediately when you enroll. Paid courses open once the payment is completed successfully.

s3.heading: Quizzes and certificates
s3.body: Quizzes are graded automatically. A certificate is issued after you complete every lesson and pass all of the course's quizzes.

s4.heading: For instructors
s4.body: Create the course from the instructor dashboard, add chapters and lessons, then press "Publish". If your account is not approved yet, the course goes to admin review first.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.intro: The questions we are asked most often.

s1.heading: Do I keep a course after buying it?
s1.body: Yes. The course stays in your account and you can come back to it at any time.

s2.heading: Which payment methods are available?
s2.body: Card payments are available today. More methods are coming and will appear on the checkout page once enabled.

s3.heading: How do I use a coupon?
s3.body: Enter the coupon code on the checkout page before completing the purchase; the discount is applied to the final price.

s4.heading: How do I get my certificate?
s4.body: Complete all lessons and pass the course's quizzes. Your certificate then appears under "My Certificates".

s5.heading: How can I verify a certificate?
s5.body: Open the verification page and enter the certificate number printed on it.

s6.heading: How do I become an instructor?
s6.body: Sign up as an instructor. The admin team reviews your application and your courses before they are published.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: By using the platform you agree to the following terms.

s1.heading: Your account
s1.body: You are responsible for keeping your sign-in details private and for all activity on your account.

s2.heading: Content
s2.body: Course content belongs to its owners. Copying or republishing it without permission is not allowed.

s3.heading: Payments
s3.body: Prices are shown before payment, and a course is unlocked once the payment provider confirms the payment.

s4.heading: Acceptable use
s4.body: Abusing the platform, circumventing its systems or harassing other users is not allowed.

s5.heading: Suspension
s5.body: The admin team may suspend any account that violates these terms.

s6.heading: Changes
s6.body: We may update these terms from time to time and will announce important changes on the platform.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This page explains what data we collect and how we use it.

s1.heading: Data we collect
s1.body: Your name, email and the profile details you add, plus your course progress and quiz results.

s2.heading: How we use it
s2.body: To run your account, track your progress, issue certificates and contact you about your account and courses.

s3.heading: Payments
s3.body: Card details are processed directly by the payment provider; we do not store card numbers on our servers.

s4.heading: Sharing
s4.body: We do not sell your data. Instructors only see the names of students enrolled in their own courses.

s5.heading: Security
s5.body: We use hashed passwords and secure connections, and restrict data access by role.

s6.heading: Your rights
s6.body: You can edit your data in Settings, or contact us to request deletion of your account.

rejected.description: Read the admin's note below, update your details and resubmit your application.
rejected.noReason: No specific reason was given. Please review your details, make sure they're complete and resubmit.

approved.title: Your application is approved!
approved.description: Congratulations! Your instructor account is active, and you can now create courses and start teaching.

sections.personalHint: Basic contact details. These aren't shown to students.
sections.teachingHint: Tell us what you teach and which grades you work with.
sections.aboutHint: Your bio appears on your public profile; links help us get to know your teaching style.

placeholders.name: e.g. Ahmed Mohamed Ali
placeholders.headline: e.g. Math teacher for secondary stage
placeholders.subjects: Type a subject and press Enter
placeholders.university: e.g. Cairo University – Faculty of Education
placeholders.bio: Tell us about your experience, how you explain lessons and what your students have achieved...

hints.phone: We'll contact you on this number about your application.
hints.headline: A short line shown under your name on your public profile.
hints.subjects: Press Enter or a comma to add a subject ({count} of {max}).
hints.gradeLevels: Select every grade level you teach.
hints.cvUrl: A Google Drive or Dropbox link; make sure the file is viewable.
hints.introVideoUrl: A short clip of you explaining part of a lesson (YouTube or Google Drive).

errors.termsRequired: You must accept the confirmation and terms to submit
errors.bioTooShort: Your bio is too short; write at least {min} characters
errors.invalidUrl: Enter a valid link starting with http:// or https://
errors.yearsInvalid: Enter a whole number from 0 to 60
errors.graduationYearInvalid: Enter a valid year between 1950 and {max}

adminInstructorReview.description: Review teacher applications, approve or reject them, and keep track of every instructor on the platform

adminInstructorReview.emptyDescription: Try another tab or change your search.
